scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:hr && npm run lint:desk
scripts.diff: npx @google/design.md diff DESIGN.history/$(ls -t DESIGN.history | head -1) DESIGN.md
scripts.export:tailwind: mkdir -p exports && node scripts/build-tailwind-v4.mjs --source DESIGN.md > exports/tokens.css
scripts.export:tailwind:hr: mkdir -p exports && node scripts/build-tailwind-v4.mjs --source DESIGN.hr.md > exports/tokens.hr.css
scripts.export:tailwind:desk: mkdir -p exports && node scripts/build-tailwind-v4.mjs --source DESIGN.desk.md > exports/tokens.desk.css
scripts.export:tailwind:all: npm run export:tailwind && npm run export:tailwind:hr && npm run export:tailwind:desk
scripts.export:dart:desk: mkdir -p exports && node scripts/build-dart-tokens.mjs --source DESIGN.desk.md > exports/tokens.desk.dart
scripts.export:dart:hr: mkdir -p exports && node scripts/build-dart-tokens.mjs --source DESIGN.hr.md > exports/tokens.hr.dart
scripts.export:dart:all: npm run export:dart:desk && npm run export:dart:hr
scripts.export:spec: node scripts/build-spec-json.mjs --source DESIGN.desk.md --out exports/spec/desk && node scripts/build-spec-json.mjs --source DESIGN.hr.md --out exports/spec/hr && node scripts/build-spec-json.mjs --source DESIGN.md --out exports/spec/group
scripts.export:dtcg: mkdir -p exports && npx @google/design.md export --format dtcg DESIGN.md > exports/tokens.dtcg.json
scripts.verify: npm run sync:check && npm run check:institution-colors && npm run check:category-icons && npm run lint:all && npm run lint:dark:strict && npm run lint:prose:strict
scripts.test:exports: npm run export:tailwind:all && node scripts/test-tailwind-export.mjs && npm run export:dart:all && npm run export:spec && node scripts/test-app-exports.mjs
scripts.build:examples: npm run export:tailwind && node scripts/build-examples-html.mjs > exports/examples.html
